reviews.title: The Death Korps of Krieg Codex
reviews.body: Should've just called this the Death Korps of Krieg supplement.If you're an IG player, Cadians aren't IT anymore. If you have Catachans, just be happy you're still in the book. Everyone else...you're funny-looking Cadians or Kriegers now.If you're new to the hobby and want to play Guard, cool. You literally won't know what you've lost because you never had it.If you're an old Guard player like me, well, we're the fething Imperial Guard!We adapt or die. We win or die. We endure or we die.We'll get through this or we won't, in which case it becomes someone else's problem.The Emperor Protects!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on August 23, 2025
reviews.author: Jason Fuentes

reviews.title: Great codex. CADIA STANDS!
reviews.body: Arrived with some damage on the front cover. Although I am pretty sure this is from the delivery drivers just throwing packages around, and not packing books in a slim, padded box has something to do with the damage, I’m sure it’s not the sellers fault. It’s rather small, but kind of annoying. Other than that, could it be cheaper? Probably so, but it’s warhammer and worth it.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on November 7, 2025
